AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

17. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.

21. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

22. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
